# Multi-KB Workflow — verify KB isolation across multiple knowledge bases

# === INIT KB-A ===
exec akb init kb-a
stdout 'Initialized KB .kb-a.'

# === INIT KB-B ===
exec akb init kb-b
stdout 'Initialized KB .kb-b.'

# === REGISTRY SHOWS BOTH ===
exec akb registry
stdout 'kb-a'
stdout 'kb-b'

# === USE KB-A AND WRITE ===
exec akb use kb-a
stdout 'Default KB set to ''kb-a'''

stdin note-a.md
exec akb write note-a.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/note-a.md'

# === VERIFY KB-A HAS ONLY ITS PAGE ===
exec akb list
stdout 'notes/note-a.md'
! stdout 'note-b'

exec akb search 'knowledge base A'
stdout 'notes/note-a.md'
! stdout 'note-b'

# === SWITCH TO KB-B AND WRITE ===
exec akb use kb-b
stdout 'Default KB set to ''kb-b'''

stdin note-b.md
exec akb write note-b.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/note-b.md'

# === VERIFY KB-B HAS ONLY ITS PAGE ===
exec akb list
stdout 'notes/note-b.md'
! stdout 'note-a'

exec akb search 'knowledge base B'
stdout 'notes/note-b.md'
! stdout 'note-a'

# === VERIFY KB-A IS UNCHANGED ===
exec akb use kb-a
stdout 'Default KB set to ''kb-a'''

exec akb list
stdout 'notes/note-a.md'
! stdout 'note-b'

exec akb search 'knowledge base A'
stdout 'notes/note-a.md'
! stdout 'note-b'

# === FINAL REGISTRY ===
exec akb registry
stdout 'kb-a'
stdout 'kb-b'

-- note-a.md --
---
type: note
title: Note in KB A
summary: Page for KB A
tags: multikb
---
Content for knowledge base A.

-- note-b.md --
---
type: note
title: Note in KB B
summary: Page for KB B
tags: multikb
---
Content for knowledge base B.
